title: Crisp Tunisian Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the freshness of fish with the spices of Tunisia, all on a crispy yellowed onion base.
instructions: Soak skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine fish, harissa, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Thread fish onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush yellowed onion slices with olive oil and grill until crispy.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve immediately with grilled onions, parsley, and lemon wedges.
Let sit for 5 minutes before serving to allow juices to redistribute.
